passages.text: Then Abijah rested with his fathers and was buried in the City of David. And his son Asa reigned in his place, and in his days the land was at peace for ten years.
passages.sermon:
Abijah was king of Judah.
Abijah died.
People buried Abijah in the City of David.
Asa was Abijah’s son.
Asa became king after Abijah.
During Asa’s reign, the land had peace.
The land was peaceful for ten years.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁכַּ֨ב אֲבִיָּ֜ה עִם־ אֲבֹתָ֗יו וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בְּעִ֣יר דָּוִ֔יד וַיִּמְלֹ֛ךְ אָסָ֥א בְנ֖וֹ תַּחְתָּ֑יו בְּיָמָ֛יו שָׁקְטָ֥ה הָאָ֖רֶץ עֶ֥שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃פ

passages.text: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Asa served the LORD, the God of his ancestors.
Asa did what was good.
Asa did what was right.
The LORD his God saw Asa’s actions.
The LORD approved of Asa’s actions.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ אָסָא֙ הַטּ֣וֹב וְהַיָּשָׁ֔ר בְּעֵינֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהָֽיו׃

passages.text: He removed the foreign altars and high places, shattered the sacred pillars, and chopped down the Asherah poles.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
Asa removed the foreign altars.
Asa removed the high places.
Asa shattered the sacred pillars.
Asa chopped down the Asherah poles.
passages.original: וַיָּ֛סַר אֶת־ מִזְבְּח֥וֹת הַנֵּכָ֖ר וְהַבָּמ֑וֹת וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־ הַמַּצֵּב֔וֹת וַיְגַדַּ֖ע אֶת־ הָאֲשֵׁרִֽים׃

passages.text: He commanded the people of Judah to seek the LORD, the God of their fathers, and to observe the law and the commandments.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.
Asa spoke to the people of Judah.
He told them to seek the LORD.
The LORD is the God of their fathers.
He told them to obey the law.
He told them to keep the commandments.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ לִֽיהוּדָ֔ה לִדְר֕וֹשׁ אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וְלַעֲשׂ֖וֹת הַתּוֹרָ֥ה וְהַמִּצְוָֽה׃

passages.text: He also removed the high places and incense altars from all the cities of Judah, and under him the kingdom was at peace.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He removed the high places from all the cities of Judah.
He removed the incense altars from all the cities of Judah.
The kingdom was at peace under Asa.
passages.original: וַיָּ֙סַר֙ מִכָּל־ עָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶת־ הַבָּמ֖וֹת וְאֶת־ הַֽחַמָּנִ֑ים וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הַמַּמְלָכָ֖ה לְפָנָֽיו׃

passages.text: Because the land was at peace, Asa built fortified cities in Judah. In those days no one made war with him, because the LORD had given him rest.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
The land was at peace.
Asa built fortified cities in Judah.
No one made war with Asa during those years.
The LORD gave Asa rest from his enemies.
passages.original: וַיִּ֛בֶן עָרֵ֥י מְצוּרָ֖ה בִּיהוּדָ֑ה כִּֽי־ שָׁקְטָ֣ה הָאָ֗רֶץ וְאֵין־ עִמּ֤וֹ מִלְחָמָה֙ בַּשָּׁנִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה כִּֽי־ הֵנִ֥יחַ יְהוָ֖ה לֽוֹ׃

passages.text: So he said to the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars. The land is still ours because we have sought the LORD our God. We have sought Him and He has given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.
passages.sermon:
Asa was king of Judah.
He spoke to the people of Judah.
He said, “Let us build these cities.
Let us put walls around them.
Let us build towers.
Let us add doors and bars to the gates.
The land still belongs to us.
We have sought the LORD our God.
We have looked for Him.
He has given us rest on every side.
So they built the cities.
They succeeded and prospered.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לִֽיהוּדָ֜ה נִבְנֶ֣ה׀ אֶת־ הֶעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְנָסֵ֨ב חוֹמָ֣ה וּמִגְדָּלִים֮ דְּלָתַ֣יִם וּבְרִיחִים֒ עוֹדֶ֨נּוּ הָאָ֜רֶץ לְפָנֵ֗ינוּ כִּ֤י דָרַ֙שְׁנוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ דָּרַ֕שְׁנוּ וַיָּ֥נַֽח לָ֖נוּ מִסָּבִ֑יב וַיִּבְנ֖וּ וַיַּצְלִֽיחוּ׃פ

passages.text: Asa had an army of 300,000 men from Judah bearing large shields and spears, and 280,000 men from Benjamin bearing small shields and drawing the bow. All these were mighty men of valor.
passages.sermon:
Asa was the king of Judah.
He had an army.
He had 300,000 men from Judah.
These men carried large shields.
They also carried spears.
He had 280,000 men from Benjamin.
These men carried small shields.
They also used bows.
All these men were mighty men of valor.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י לְאָסָ֗א חַיִל֮ נֹשֵׂ֣א צִנָּ֣ה וָרֹמַח֒ מִֽיהוּדָה֙ שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֣וֹת אֶ֔לֶףס וּמִבִּנְיָמִ֗ן נֹשְׂאֵ֤י מָגֵן֙ וְדֹ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת מָאתַ֥יִם וּשְׁמוֹנִ֖ים אָ֑לֶף כָּל־ אֵ֖לֶּה גִּבּ֥וֹרֵי חָֽיִל׃

passages.text: Then Zerah the Cushite came against them with an army of 1,000,000 men and 300 chariots, and they advanced as far as Mareshah.
passages.sermon:
Zerah was a Cushite leader.
He gathered an army.
His army had 1,000,000 men.
His army had 300 chariots.
Zerah and his army marched against Asa and Judah.
They advanced to the city of Mareshah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם זֶ֣רַח הַכּוּשִׁ֗י בְּחַ֙יִל֙ אֶ֣לֶף אֲלָפִ֔ים וּמַרְכָּב֖וֹת שְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וַיָּבֹ֖א עַד־ מָרֵשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: So Asa marched out against him and lined up in battle formation in the Valley of Zephathah near Mareshah.
passages.sermon:
Asa was the king of Judah.
Zerah the Cushite came with a large army.
Asa marched out to face Zerah.
Asa and his army prepared for battle.
They lined up in battle formation.
They stood in the Valley of Zephathah.
This valley was near Mareshah.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א אָסָ֖א לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּֽעַרְכוּ֙ מִלְחָמָ֔ה בְּגֵ֥יא צְפַ֖תָה לְמָרֵשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: Then Asa cried out to the LORD his God: “O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty. Help us, O LORD our God, for we rely on You, and in Your name we have come against this multitude. O LORD, You are our God. Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You.”
passages.sermon:
Asa was the king of Judah.
Asa faced a great enemy army.
Asa cried out to the LORD his God.
He said, “LORD, only You can help the powerless against the mighty.
No one else can do this.
Help us, LORD our God.
We rely on You.
We have come against this great army in Your name.
LORD, You are our God.
Do not let any human win against You.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אָסָ֜א אֶל־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָיו֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ יְהוָ֗ה אֵֽין־ עִמְּךָ֤ לַעְזוֹר֙ בֵּ֥ין רַב֙ לְאֵ֣ין כֹּ֔חַ עָזְרֵ֜נוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ כִּֽי־ עָלֶ֣יךָ נִשְׁעַ֔נּוּ וּבְשִׁמְךָ֣ בָ֔אנוּ עַל־ הֶהָמ֖וֹן הַזֶּ֑ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ אַ֔תָּה אַל־ יַעְצֹ֥ר עִמְּךָ֖ אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃ס

passages.text: So the LORD struck down the Cushites before Asa and Judah, and the Cushites fled.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
Asa is the king of Judah.
The LORD struck down the Cushites.
Asa and the people of Judah saw this happen.
The Cushites fled.
passages.original: וַיִּגֹּ֤ף יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַכּוּשִׁ֔ים לִפְנֵ֥י אָסָ֖א וְלִפְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיָּנֻ֖סוּ הַכּוּשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: Then Asa and his army pursued them as far as Gerar. The Cushites fell and could not recover, for they were crushed before the LORD and His army. So the people of Judah carried off a great amount of plunder and attacked all the cities around Gerar, because the terror of the LORD had fallen upon them. They plundered all the cities, since there was much plunder there.
passages.sermon:
Asa was the king of Judah.
He led his army.
They pursued the Cushites.
They chased them as far as Gerar.
The Cushites fell in battle.
None of the Cushites could recover.
The LORD crushed the Cushites.
The LORD’s army defeated them.
The people of Judah took much plunder.
They attacked all the cities around Gerar.
The terror of the LORD fell on those cities.
The people of Judah plundered all the cities.
There was much plunder in those cities.
passages.original: וַיִּרְדְּפֵ֨ם אָסָ֜א וְהָעָ֣ם אֲשֶׁר־ עִמּוֹ֮ עַד־ לִגְרָר֒ וַיִּפֹּ֤ל מִכּוּשִׁים֙ לְאֵ֣ין לָהֶ֣ם מִֽחְיָ֔ה כִּֽי־ נִשְׁבְּר֥וּ לִפְנֵֽי־ יְהוָ֖ה וְלִפְנֵ֣י מַחֲנֵ֑הוּ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ שָׁלָ֖ל הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃ וַיַּכּ֗וּ אֵ֤ת כָּל־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ סְבִיב֣וֹת גְּרָ֔ר כִּי־ הָיָ֥ה פַֽחַד־ יְהוָ֖ה עֲלֵיהֶ֑ם וַיָּבֹ֙זּוּ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים כִּֽי־ בִזָּ֥ה רַבָּ֖ה הָיְתָ֥ה בָהֶֽם׃

passages.text: They also attacked the tents of the herdsmen and carried off many sheep and camels. Then they returned to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
The army of Judah attacked the tents of the herdsmen.
They took many sheep.
They took many camels.
Then the army of Judah returned to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וְגַם־ אָהֳלֵ֥י מִקְנֶ֖ה הִכּ֑וּ וַיִּשְׁבּ֨וּ צֹ֤אן לָרֹב֙ וּגְמַלִּ֔ים וַיָּשֻׁ֖בוּ יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס
